context: Saito gives Ryosuke a year-end checkup.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 亮介さん、年末の検査、終わりました。
lines.en: Ryosuke, your year-end checkup is complete.
lines.style: Direct, clear opening with genuine warmth underneath. Professional but not distant. A slight softening on his name — she knows him. Steady pace, measured confidence in the news.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はい、結果、いかがですか？
lines.en: Yes — and how are the results?
lines.style: Respectful, careful inquiry. A held breath underneath — he's genuinely asking, not performing politeness. Slight rise at the end, genuinely wanting to hear.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 健康、良好。安心してください。
lines.en: Everything looks excellent. You can be at ease.
lines.style: Clear reassurance delivered with quiet confidence. A beat before 'excellent' — she's seen the numbers, she's sure. Gentle but factual, letting the good news land.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Relief visibly exhaled on the opening. Sincere gratitude, not perfunctory. A small emotional release after worry he was holding. Warm and genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 新年、元気で、過ごせます。
lines.en: You'll be able to enjoy the new year in good health.
lines.style: A gentle forward-looking warmth. Not clinical — she's extending a real wish. Slow, deliberate delivery on 'enjoy' — this matters beyond the medical.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 相談、いつも、感謝してます。
lines.en: I'm always grateful for your care.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded gratitude. Not apologetic — genuine acknowledgment of her attentiveness over time. Warm but not effusive. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Take care of yourself. See you next year.
lines.style: Closing warmth with a trace of the professional-personal boundary. A small smile in the voice. Neither rushed nor lingering — the natural end of a good interaction.
